_meta.title: MiniMax H3 文生视频+音频 (t2va) — 8step Turbo LoRA
_meta.source: 拓扑照抄本机 ComfyUI 0.37.0 官方蓝图 definitions/subgraphs 的 Image to Video (MiniMax H3)
notes: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo 的 first_frame/last_frame 均不接 => t2va（纯文生视频+音频）
length 必须是 17k+5 的帧数（24fps）：124 帧 ≈ 5.17 秒
官方蓝图未使用 MiniMaxH3SigmaShift，默认 shift 由模型内部处理，此处同样省略
torbo LoRA 走 LoraLoaderModelOnly；官方蓝图默认关闭，这里开启用于加速基线

inputs.prompt:
Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split, humming analog synth drone rises.
[1s-2s] Camera pans right past a chrome palm tree; a deep synth bass note swells in sync with the pan.
[2s-3s] A marble Greek statue head rotates slowly toward camera; a soft chime rings out, matching the rotation.
[3s-4s] Pink and blue gradient sky pulses; tape hiss and a distant seagull cry layer over the synth pad.
[4s-5s] The chrome palm trees glow as the sun sets; the analog synth resolves into a warm sustained chord.

Audio: continuous analog synth pad, tape hiss, one chime, one deep bass swell, one distant seagull cry.
